product: Calculate across rows in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview)
tagline: Use the Multi Row Formula operator in Lakeflow Designer for running totals, ranks, moving averages, and other calculations across ordered rows.
what_it_does: Use the Multi Row Formula operator in Lakeflow Designer for running totals, ranks, moving averages, and other calculations across ordered rows. Lakeflow Designer includes built in operators for common data preparation and transformation tasks. Open the Operators pane on the left to browse operators by category, or use Search for an operator...
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
